description: Point a feature key your code sends, such as "search", at a feature or an area on the map. Pass neither target to clear it. Notes, errors and use follow the key, including dotted descendants without a more specific link. A person's link wins over code and observed use. Clearing it allows automatic matching again. Unlinked dotted keys use the longest linked prefix. Use per feature updates after the next daily count. A product keeps at most 2,000 feature keys: a new key past that gets a 409, but an existing key can still be relinked. ENGINEER+ required.

area.description: An area slug from list_areas. Leave out with featureId

featureId.description: Feature id (uuid) from list_features. Leave out with area

key.description: The feature key your code sends, such as "search" or "chat.answers"

name: link_feature_key
title: Link a feature key
